runtime_audio_listener.boundary: Serialized independent rig listener, not MainCamera position. Unity native reverb preset 27 is source evidence, not a claim Godot reverb is equivalent.

boundaries: Quaternion component Hermite then normalization is a declared adapter of original nonweighted legacy curves, not a native Unity interpolation golden sample.
Generated source uses SoundConfig default template minDistance100/max500/linear; do not use minDistance1 from unrelated audio-anchor component.
Source Unity spatialBlend1, listener position and native pan/mixer/ducking must be separately mapped; 2D mono playback is not equivalent spatialization.

execution_contract.action_order: Run enabled actions in serialized order; skip disabled. All selected states have is_sequence=false. If an action requests transition, ActivateActions stops later actions.
execution_contract.AnimationPlaythroughAction: Starts Animation.Play if crossFade<=Mathf.Epsilon, else CrossFade, then immediately Finish; no OnUpdate, no waiting for clip completion.
execution_contract.Wait: realTime=false here: accumulate Time.deltaTime, Finish and directly send finishEvent once timer>=time. Disabled Wait does nothing.
execution_contract.MousePickRandomAction: GetMouseButtonDown(0), pointer over collider, InputUtil gate. OnEnter checkFirstFrame runs same pick check. ctor m_opened=true. OnEnter redraws integer Range(min,max) iff opened, then sets opened=false. Count persists across state reentry. On threshold sets opened=true and clears count when ResetOnOpen.
execution_contract.frame_boundary: PlayMaker UpdateStateChanges loops pending transitions in the same update; do not assume a checkFirstFrame mouse action in the new state needs a new physical press. InputCollection delegates to IInput; initialized with UnityInput. Further native/provider equivalence is documented in SOURCE_REPORT.
